notes: Policy data, not legal advice: the platform flags and cites a license, counsel decides.
Families are matched against the lowercased license expression, one token at a time
(expressions like 'MIT OR GPL-2.0-only' are split on AND / OR / WITH and parentheses).
Any license that matches neither list is reported as not covered by the policy, with
verdict insufficient_evidence. Missing data is never treated as compliant.

restrictive.name: AGPL
restrictive.summary: Affero GPL: network use counts as distribution, so the source obligation reaches a hosted service.

restrictive.name: SSPL
restrictive.summary: Server Side Public License: offering the software as a service triggers a source-release obligation for the service stack.

restrictive.name: GPL
restrictive.summary: Strong copyleft: distributing the product with this component obliges releasing the combined work under the same terms.
